frequency_question: How often do announced central ministry manufacturing schemes successfully reach formal gazette notification and implementation within their target timeframe?
membership_rule: Members are major central ministry schemes targeting manufacturing or vehicle subsidies announced with implementation timelines; excluded are minor circulars, draft-only proposals, and non-financial policy guidelines.

Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles (FAME I)

coverage_note: 8 named major manufacturing and vehicle subsidy schemes; all successfully reached formal notification once prioritized by the relevant ministry.
known_gaps: May slightly overrepresent high-priority flagship programs due to public visibility bias in historical tracking.
validity_reason: Bureaucratic notification procedures and gazette publication norms for central government financial schemes remain stable across medium-term administrative cycles.
